<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915493_theRebbe_561" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915493_theRebbe_561__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the two reasons why Yaakov's work in Lavan's house was necessary before he could refine Esav.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the reason that in order to refine Esav, his work in the house of Lavan had to come first,</t>
    <t s="2">is explained in several discourses,</t>
    <t s="3">and at length in the discourse beginning "Vayishlach" in the continuation of the year 5672,</t>
    <t s="4">[concerning] two matters in this.</t>
    <t s="5">The first,</t>
    <t s="6">that in order to refine Esav, a most exalted light was needed,</t>
    <t s="7">and therefore his work in the house of Lavan had to come first,</t>
    <t s="8">[which is] the aspect of the supernal whiteness that is above the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="9">And after, through his work in the house of Lavan over the course of twenty years, he drew down all the lights of the aspect of the supernal whiteness,</t>
    <t s="10">even to the matter of "And he [Lavan] arose early in the morning and kissed his sons and his daughters etc.",</t>
    <t s="11">the drawing down of the supernal whiteness in the aspect of kisses and the adhesion of spirit to spirit to all the matters of Yaakov,</t>
    <t s="12">(to the influencers and the recipients,</t>
    <t s="13">his sons and his daughters),</t>
    <t s="14">he was able to refine Esav.</t>
    <t s="15">And the second,</t>
    <t s="16">that the need for the preparatory work in the house of Lavan in order to refine Esav is</t>
    <t s="17">(not only from the side of the root of Lavan,</t>
    <t s="18">the supernal whiteness,</t>
    <t s="19">but also)</t>
    <t s="20">from the side of the lower Lavan,</t>
    <t s="21">Lavan of the kelipah.</t>
    <t s="22">For Esav is lower than Lavan,</t>
    <t s="23">for Lavan is [the sefiros of] Chochmah, Binah, and Daas of the side of impurity, and Esav is [the sefiros of] Zeir Anpin and Malchus of the side of impurity,</t>
    <t s="24">and therefore one must first refine Lavan,</t>
    <t s="25">and afterwards go to refine Esav.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Yaakov's refinements were from above downward, unlike the current order of refinement which is from below upward.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the matter is,</t>
    <t s="2">that the refinements of Yaakov were, in general, in a manner of from above downward,</t>
    <t s="3">by means of the revelation of a supernal light.</t>
    <t s="4">For Yaakov is Torah,</t>
    <t s="5">[as is known,</t>
    <t s="6">that the three Patriarchs are the three lines: Torah, service, and acts of kindness,</t>
    <t s="7">Avraham—acts of kindness,</t>
    <t s="8">Yitzchak—service,</t>
    <t s="9">and Yaakov—Torah],</t>
    <t s="10">and the refinement that is through Torah is in a manner of from above downward,</t>
    <t s="11">as explained in the discourse beginning "Padeh BeShalom"</t>
    <t s="12">regarding the distinction between the refinement of prayer and the refinement of Torah,</t>
    <t s="13">that the refinement of prayer is in a manner of from below upward</t>
    <t s="14">(it engages with the thing being refined),</t>
    <t s="15">and the refinement of Torah is in a manner of from above downward.</t>
    <t s="16">For the distinction between these two matters is not only in the manner of refinement,</t>
    <t s="17">but also in the order of refinement.</t>
    <t s="18">For in the refinement that is in the manner of from below upward</t>
    <t s="19">(it engages with the thing being refined),</t>
    <t s="20">the order of refinement is also from below upward,</t>
    <t s="21">that first one refines the lower and afterwards the upper,</t>
    <t s="22">and the refinement in the manner of from above downward</t>
    <t s="23">(by means of the revelation of light from above)</t>
    <t s="24">is in an order of from above downward.</t>
    <t s="25">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="26">in the refinements now,</t>
    <t s="27">which are</t>
    <t s="28">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="29">in a manner of from below upward,</t>
    <t s="30">the order is that the refinement of the seven lower [sefiros] precedes the refinement of the three upper [sefiros],</t>
    <t s="31">and this is why at first there was the conquest of the land of the seven nations and afterwards</t>
    <t s="32">(in the future)</t>
    <t s="33">will be the conquest of the Keni, Kenizi, and Kadmoni,</t>
    <t s="34">and known is the explanation of the Baal HaGeulah of Yud Tes Kislev</t>
    <t s="35">[that the ascent of Yud Tes Kislev is on the Shabbos that follows it]</t>
    <t s="36">that in the conquest of Yehoshua only the seven [lower] sefiros were refined</t>
    <t s="37">(and the intellectual faculties that relate to the [lower] sefiros),</t>
    <t s="38">and the three upper [sefiros] will be refined in the future,</t>
    <t s="39">but not so in the refinements of Yaakov,</t>
    <t s="40">which were in a manner of from above downward,</t>
    <t s="41">the order was that first he refined [the sefiros of] Chochmah, Binah, and Daas</t>
    <t s="42">(Lavan)</t>
    <t s="43">and afterwards [the sefiros of] Zeir Anpin and Malchus</t>
    <t s="44">(Esav).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the advantage of refinement from below upward over refinement from above downward, and how Yaakov's refinement empowered the later refinement.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, it is known,</t>
    <t s="2">that although in general the refinement in a manner of from above downward is more exalted than the refinement in a manner of from below upward,</t>
    <t s="3">there is an advantage in the refinement in a manner of from below upward over the refinement in a manner of from above downward,</t>
    <t s="4">for the refinement in a manner of from above downward,</t>
    <t s="5">since the refinement is from the side of the revelation of light</t>
    <t s="6">(and not from the side of the lower entity itself),</t>
    <t s="7">it does not relate so much to the lower entity itself,</t>
    <t s="8">but not so in the refinement in a manner of from below upward,</t>
    <t s="9">the lower entity itself becomes a vessel for Elokus.</t>
    <t s="10">And this is why even after Yaakov effected the refinement of Esav,</t>
    <t s="11">even to the point of "And Esav ran toward him and embraced him etc. and kissed him",</t>
    <t s="12">he [Yaakov] said to him,</t>
    <t s="13">"I will proceed slowly etc. until I come to my lord, to Seir",</t>
    <t s="14">and when will he go? In the days of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="15">as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="16">"And saviors shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esav",</t>
    <t s="17">for the refinement of Esav that was done by Yaakov was through the revelation of light from above</t>
    <t s="18">(as above),</t>
    <t s="19">and therefore the refinement was not complete,</t>
    <t s="20">and the completion of his refinement in the days of Moshiach is through our deeds and service during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="21">[which is] refinement in a manner of from below upward.</t>
    <t s="22">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="23">that this, that his refinement first came about through Yaakov in a manner of from above downward, is a giving of power so that afterwards the refinement in a manner of from below upward could be.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
